Four Family Members Found Dead in Mumbai Home; Police Investigate

A navy sailor, his wife, and their two children were discovered deceased in their south Mumbai residence. Police have initiated an investigation into the incident, with preliminary suspicions pointing towards a murder-suicide scenario. The exact cause of death and the sequence of events are currently under examination.
